payload.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=empirical+case+studies+of+computational+creativity+in+autonomous+scientific+discovery+agents&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-94-009-9015-9_1\", \"title\": [\"Scientific Judgment: Creativity and Discovery in Scientific Thought\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-009-9015-9_1\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1980]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-94-010-1284-3_15\", \"title\": [\"Cognitive Psychology, Scientific Creativity, and the Case Study Method\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-94-010-1284-3_15\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1981]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.7551/mitpress/6090.003.0006\", \"title\": [\"Discovering Quantitative Empirical Laws\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.7551/mitpress/6090.003.0006\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1987]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.20944/preprints202603.1694.v1\", \"title\": [\"A Brief History of AI for Scientific Discovery: Open Research, Metrics, and Autonomous Agents\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:p>The history of artificial intelligence for scientific discovery is not a two year story about chatbots learning to write papers. It is a sixty year story about science repeatedly handing its bottlenecks to machines—first inference, then search, then measurement, then the full workflow—only to discover that each delegation solves one problem and exposes a harder one underneath. This paper traces that history from DENDRAL (1965) through the construction of open scholarly infrastructure (arXiv, Google Scholar, ORCID), the oracle breakthroughs of AlphaFold, and the current era of LLM driven autonomous research agents.
